title: UU HPP: individual layers and corporate rate from tax year 2022
summary: The progressive layers on individual taxable income widen the first band to Rp60 million and add a 35% layer above Rp5 billion. DJP said the UU PPh changes apply from tax year 2022.

legal_basis.title: Presiden RI Sahkan UU Harmonisasi Peraturan Perpajakan
legal_basis.instrument: UU No. 7 Tahun 2021, Pasal 17 ayat (1) huruf a UU PPh
legal_basis.pinpoint: Tabel lapisan UU PPh versus UU HPP. Perubahan UU PPh berlaku mulai Tahun Pajak 2022.

legal_basis.title: UU No. 7 Tahun 2021 tentang Harmonisasi Peraturan Perpajakan
legal_basis.instrument: UU 7/2021, Pasal 3, perubahan Pasal 17 ayat (1) huruf b UU PPh

legal_basis.title: Fasilitas pengurangan tarif Pasal 31E
legal_basis.instrument: UU PPh Pasal 31E ayat (1), penjelasan DJP Lima Jenis Tarif PPh Badan
legal_basis.pinpoint: Wajib Pajak badan dalam negeri; peredaran bruto sampai Rp50 miliar; pengurangan tarif 50% atas PKP dari bagian peredaran bruto sampai Rp4,8 miliar

verification.notes: Layers are those in the DJP comparison table. They apply per slice of taxable income.

changes.summary: Replace the four-layer individual schedule with the five-layer UU HPP schedule. This is the annual Pasal 17 computation, not the 2024 monthly TER.

computation.notes: Layers from 2022: 5% to Rp60 million; 15% to Rp250 million; 25% to Rp500 million; 30% to Rp5 billion; 35% above Rp5 billion. Each rate applies only to its slice.

migration_impact.summary: Payroll annualisation for tax year 2022 must use the new layers. Do not apply 35% to income below Rp5 billion.

before.description: 5% to Rp50 million; 15% to Rp250 million; 25% to Rp500 million; 30% above Rp500 million.

after.description: 5% to Rp60 million; 15% to Rp250 million; 25% to Rp500 million; 30% to Rp5 billion; 35% above Rp5 billion.

changes.summary: Record the HPP 22% corporate rate from tax year 2022 and the conditional Article 31E reduction. Earlier corporate rate history is not reconstructed.

computation.notes: Article 31E applies a 50% rate reduction only to the eligible taxable-income portion; not a blanket 11% tax on turnover or all profits.

migration_impact.summary: Separate ordinary corporate taxable income, qualifying Article 31E allocations, and final-taxed turnover. The reference resolver does not determine relief eligibility.

after.description: Article 31E qualifying portion takes 50% of this rate; residual taxable income uses the ordinary rate.
